description:
Join the Wendy McCallum Affiliate Program

Turn art, emotion, and creativity into income.

The Wendy McCallum Affiliate Program is built for creators who love sharing meaningful, expressive, and joyful art with their audience. Whether your content leans spiritual, lifestyle, home décor, or playful seasonal vibes, we reward creators who genuinely connect people with art that feels good.

Earn commission on every sale generated through your unique affiliate link or discount code, while growing with a brand that values creativity over hard selling.


Why Join Wendy McCallum Art?

✔ Art with soul, story, and emotional resonance

✔ Boutique, artist-led brand (not mass-produced)

✔ Flexible, creator-first affiliate model

✔ Performance-based tier system that grows with you

Our tiered structure makes it easy to start, rewarding as you grow, and meaningful for long-term collaborators.


Affiliate Tiers & Benefits

Tier 1: Bronze Partners

For creators just getting started with as an affiliate for Wendy McCallum Arts.

Who Qualifies:

Newly onboarded influencers

Benefits:

10% fixed commission on all sales

Personalised affiliate link + discount code

Ability to purchase products at cost price (hoodies, tees, prints)

Welcome support pack (brand story, product highlights, creative ideas)

Why It Works:

Most creators are testing new partnerships. This tier offers a simple, low-pressure way to start earning and posting authentically.


Tier 2: Silver Partners

For creators actively driving sales and engagement

Who Qualifies:

Influencers generating £2,000–£5,000 in monthly revenue

Benefits:

10% fixed commission

Monthly freebies (hoodies, tees, prints, or seasonal merch)

Early access to new releases and campaigns

Higher visibility on Wendy McCallum Art social pages (features & shares)

Why It Works:

Creators are rewarded with both income and product value, helping them create better content and convert more confidently.


Tier 3: Gold Partners

For top-performing creators and long-term collaborators

Who Qualifies:

Influencers generating £5,000+ in monthly revenue

Benefits:

15% commission

Monthly freebies with priority product selection

Exclusive promotions, collaborations, or capsule content opportunities

Featured Ambassador status (website & social shoutouts)

First access to new collections

Why It Works:

Gold Partners receive stronger financial rewards and deeper brand alignment, turning top performers into long-term ambassadors.


Commission & Discount Codes

Commission rates are tier-based and performance-driven

Each affiliate receives a personalised discount code (e.g. PARTNER10)

All sales are automatically tracked using Wendy’s affiliate dashboard.

Simple, transparent, and reliable.


Free Merch Policy

Bronze Partners: Products available at cost price

Silver & Gold Partners: Free or priority access to merch


Who Can Apply?

We’re looking for creators who align with our brand values and aesthetics.

Priority:

UK & Scotland-based creators

Also Considered:

International creators in wellness, lifestyle, home décor, or artistic niches

All applications are reviewed manually to ensure genuine alignment.


Payouts

Tracked automatically via affiliate app.

Payout schedule follows platform setup (monthly)

Minimum payout threshold applies

No guesswork. No chasing payments.


Your Role as an Affiliate

✔ Promote Wendy McCallum Art authentically

✔ Share content aligned with our values and tone

✔ Use your link or code responsibly

✔ Create original, honest content (no forced selling)


Our Commitment to You

✔ Access to creatives and product imagery

✔ Clear communication and support

✔ Performance-based rewards and tier upgrades

✔ A genuine, creator-friendly partnership


How to Join

Apply using the link

Your application is reviewed by our team

Once approved, you’ll receive:

A welcome message

Your unique affiliate link

Personal discount code

Start sharing and earning


Ready to Create, Share & Earn?

If you love meaningful art, playful creativity, and authentic partnerships, we’d love to work with you.

👉 Apply to become a Wendy McCallum Affiliate today
